name: Zophar
overview: Zophar the Naamathite is introduced in Scripture as one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him in his suffering, alongside Eliphaz and Bildad (Job 2:11). However, despite their intentions, God rebukes them for not speaking rightly about Him, unlike Job (Job 42:7). As a result, they were instructed to offer sacrifices and seek Job's intercession, which God accepted (Job 42:8-9). This account highlights the importance of rightly representing God, even in times of trial and counsel.
